extras.title: Play on PC: MK4 v17 lighting in a Windows MAME fork
extras.description: Updated 9 October 2026: MAME 0.289 development snapshot a025aba9 with the MK4 v17 RTL material-response and blend changes ported to the mk4 version 3.0 driver. The calibration is empirical; original Zeus lighting microcode has not been recovered and visual differences remain. This fork is not made or supported by the MAME team. No ROMs are included.
extras.install: Extract the archive, keep your existing nvram and cfg folders when upgrading, put your own mk4.zip and tms320c32.zip in roms, then run Play MK4 (lighting).bat.

files.label: PCB comparison images, method and validation

extras.media_title: Original PCB capture versus v17 RTL
extras.media_note: All nine arenas. PCB frames use one fixed white/black calibration from Kombat Kode text and blank-frame black. The comparison side is actual v17 RTL replay, not cabinet or MAME footage. Poses and effect phases differ. The MAME port matches 433,844 vertex results and 5,243,616 pixel operations checked against that RTL; separate executable captures from all nine arenas are included in the evidence download. These checks do not prove a pixel-perfect PCB match.
